headline: Reference databases add LLM-assisted curation, expanded coverage and programmatic access
label: Biological Reference Database Infrastructure
summary: Recent updates to cancer, literature and chemical exposure resources, plus an LLM curation preprint, expand data coverage and annotation layers.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the extension of curated reference resources with computational annotation layers and broader coverage. canSAR 2026 integrates multi-source cancer drug discovery data with machine-learning predictors and druggability tools. Europe PMC 2026 adds new machine-learning annotations and text-mined annotations to an open literature database of 48 million abstracts. SynCED presents a substantially updated and expanded successor to the Toxin and Toxin Target Database, focused on synthetic chemical exposure. GeneScribe, a preprint, applies large language models to extract literature facts and draft gene function summaries for Alliance of Genome Resources curation. The shared element is the use of machine learning and language models to support curation and annotation within established resources, rather than a common method across all four items. The new content lies in expanded scope and automated annotation.
